beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Tour's over. Riley's back in the chair, restless in a different way than usual.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Everyone wants me to just pick — keep making the big radio-ready stuff, or go all the way into what I've been writing on my own. Nobody thinks I can do both."

options.text: Maybe the answer isn't picking one.
Then you'd better hurry up and choose.
Why not let someone else decide for you?

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't even know what 'not picking' would sound like. Feels like avoiding the real question."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: It's not avoidance — it's mixing what looks like opposites into something bigger than either one.
It means you have to force the two into matching exactly.
This card has nothing to do with combining anything.

elaboration: Temperance is alchemy — blending different, even opposing, ingredients into something greater than either alone.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So I just throw the pop stuff and the raw stuff together and hope it works?"

options.text: Not thrown together — tempered. It takes patience to actually find the balance.
Yes, exactly, just smash them together.
Patience doesn't factor into this at all.

elaboration: Patience and experience refine raw experience into wisdom — moderation means finding the right balance, not swinging to whichever extreme feels safest today.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "...Okay. Maybe I've been treating this like a fork in the road instead of something I actually get to blend myself."
